newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Assa Abloy says VingCard buys Elsafe.
newsitem.headline: Assa Abloy says VingCard buys Elsafe.

text.p: Swedish locks company Assa Abloy said on Monday that its hotel security unit VingCard had acquired the Norwegian electronic hotel safe group Elsafe for 107 million Norwegian crowns.
After the acquisition, VingCard's sales will amount to about 800 million Norwegian crowns proforma, the company said in a statement.
"VingCard estimates that rationalisation and synergies will lead to positive profit improvements within a few years," Assa Abloy said.
Elsafe's 1997 sales are expected to amount to 140 million Norwegian crowns and its pre-tax profit is seen at 17 million.
"The acquisition is expected to have a positive effect on Assa Abloy's earnings per share already in 1997," it said.
